name: Silas Reed
description:
A gaunt, twitchy man in his thirties with haunted eyes that rarely blink, his hands constantly checking the crude 'dream-ward' amulets sewn into his worn coat.

Key Traits: haunted, paranoid, obsessive

Primary Goal: Stitch the Veil back together
background: A former low-level Veil Warden scribe who witnessed the corruption of his superiors by a subtle dream-entity. He defected with stolen schematics for the Legion's first crude wards.
goals: To perfect a 'Great Ward'—a device that could permanently seal all dream-gates, no matter the cost in lives or resources.
